table.name: TLGNC_FREIGHT_COST
table.description: Freight cost lookup table. Used by the freight cost calculation algorithm.

column.name: FREIGHT_COST_ID
column.description: PK. This is a Logon-internal, technical identifier.

column.name: MATERIAL_PACKAGE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_material_package_bs. Material package type. SAP: material_general_Data (MARA) / MAGRV, Material group: Packaging Materials. Remark: Altough the package type does allow the storage of Pallet, Silo and Service types. They are not used in the freight cost calculation. Only package types that are convertible to tons are used.

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_sarea. The Sales Area, which consists of Sales Organistaion + Distribution Channel + Division

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. Shippingpoint. NULL means that the rate calculation can be applied for all shippingpoints. Remark: in case of ambiguity the Shipping point has higher priority than the country.

column.name: COUNTRY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_sap_country_bs. Country code, NULL means that the rate calculation can be applied for all countries. Remark: in case of ambiguity the Shipping point has higher priority than the country.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. Currency of the freight rate.

column.name: RATE
column.description: Rate expressed in curency per Km per Ton
